style: Original instrumental soundtrack for a warm, whimsical cartoon martial-arts adventure in a mythological ancient river civilization. Acoustic lyre, oud-like plucked lute, wooden reed flute, frame drum, soft hand percussion and restrained strings. Simple memorable pentatonic melodies in D dorian, with a recurring rising D-F-G-A invitation motif. Playful character and inviting human warmth, clear musical phrasing, modest ensemble, intimate rather than epic cinematic production. No vocals, no speech, no choir, no modern drum kit or electric guitars. Compose a continuous reusable game theme: established groove from the first bar, no long introduction, no final cadence or fade-out, maintain energy through the ending so a gentle overlap can loop it.

tracks.title: A Tablet at Your Door
tracks.prompt: Main overworld theme. A curious young challenger sets out from a sunlit courtyard. Gentle lyre invitation melody, bouncing lute ostinato, soft frame drum, an answering reed flute. Welcoming, lightly mischievous exploration, room to breathe. 96 BPM.

tracks.title: A Cushion for Tomorrow
tracks.prompt: Sanctuary interior theme. A kind elder offers tea, rest and another chance. Soft thumb-plucked lyre, low wooden flute and quiet sustained strings, sparse brushed hand drum. A tender variation of the invitation motif, restful and reassuring with a little grandfatherly humor. 96 BPM felt in half time.

tracks.title: Clay, Coins and Conversation
tracks.prompt: Clay market and village streets. Conversational reed-flute phrases, nimble lute and lyre, little woodblock and hand drum accents. Eccentric merchants, friendly bustle, playful syncopation, never frantic or intrusive. 96 BPM.

tracks.title: Where the Reeds Bend
tracks.prompt: Canal gardens and river bridge. Flowing harp-like lyre arpeggios, a gently wandering wooden flute, soft shakers and warm low strings. Sunlight and water, quiet satisfaction from helping a garden flourish. Relaxed rippling movement, 96 BPM.

tracks.title: The Cedar Remembers
tracks.prompt: Ancient cedar grove. Low wooden flute, muted lute harmonics, resonant soft frame drum and still string drones. Stately, a little mysterious, protective and alive rather than threatening. Broad breaths and leafy rhythmic texture, a gentler low-register invitation motif. 96 BPM.

tracks.title: Lessons Above the City
tracks.prompt: Open-air training terrace. Breezy high reed flute over crisp plucked lyre, buoyant frame drums and a light rising string answer. Air and footwork, friendly determination, practicing with an eccentric teacher. Bright, spacious and nimble. 96 BPM.

tracks.title: The Court Beneath Heaven
tracks.prompt: Temple court before a divine champion. Measured deep frame drums, noble low reed melody, gold-toned lyre flourishes and restrained warm strings. Awe mixed with approachable ceremony, grand but never ominous or militaristic. 96 BPM.

tracks.title: The Reed-Court Lesson
tracks.prompt: Battle theme for a disciplined human reed-court student. Precise call-and-response between clipped lyre and wooden flute, dry hand drum footwork, sly pauses, a modest confident melody. Friendly competitive sparring, observant and resourceful rather than overwhelming. Clear energetic 120 BPM.

tracks.title: Wings Above the Terrace
tracks.prompt: Battle theme for an eccentric golden lion-headed eagle martial artist. Swooping high reed-flute runs, playful low string answers to suggest a lion's proud roar, agile lute and dancing frame drum syncopations. Aerial feints and dramatic landings, proud but lovable. Energetic 120 BPM.

tracks.title: Seven Rings of Cedar
tracks.prompt: Battle theme for a broad ancient cedar guardian with an intimidating face and a caring heart. Rooted resonant hand drums, firm low lute pattern, sturdy low reed melody, rippling lyre responses. Patient defense, sevenfold protective circles, sudden short counterphrases. Formidable and earthy, still warm adventure. 120 BPM with half-time weight.

tracks.title: The Horizon Takes a Step
tracks.prompt: Greater champion battle theme for a powerful blue celestial bull in cream robes and a star belt. Driving deep frame drums, bright ringing lyre, broad noble reed melody and rising acoustic strings. Charging momentum, starry grandeur, a characterful playful swagger, triumphant challenge rather than apocalyptic danger. 120 BPM.
